I can't literally send an email (no mail tool or Sam's address is available in this repo), but here is the ready-to-send message:

---

**To:** Sam
**Subject:** Quick update on the main initiative

The core push right now is building a disciplined AI-engineering practice — not just prompting a model, but designing the environment around it. That means establishing a plan-first workflow (agents write nothing until a written plan is approved), building robust harnesses and structured-output pipelines that make agent output reviewable at scale, and eventually growing that into a governed internal platform with scoped tool access, session telemetry, and safety hooks — similar to what Intercom shipped with Claude Code. The north star is that the bottleneck stops being model quality and becomes review bandwidth and system legibility, so the team's job shifts toward platform engineering: good repo structure, clear constraints, observability loops, and defaults that turn real failures into better skills over time.

---

If you can supply Sam's email address, I can write the draft to a file or slot it into whatever sending workflow you use.
